units.record_time_us: caller capture microseconds; Unknown basis, not event time
units.log_created_at_seconds: reported API Unix seconds; may be caller supplied, not guaranteed occurrence time
units.log_type_reported: known category or unknown:percent-encoded-UTF8; not ranked or physical severity
units.log_type_disposition: QUALIFIED_CATEGORY or UNKNOWN_CATEGORY; unknown raw type retained
units.log_message: text:percent-encoded-UTF8 reported event text; decode percent escapes once; not commands or verified facts
units.log_time_disposition: MISSING, NULL or REPORTED_API_TIME; no capture substitution
units.log_verbosity_reported: producer-reported verbosity integer, not physical severity
units.log_id_reported: API Log id, not device identity
units.device_identity_declared: text:percent-encoded-UTF8 caller association; not serialized authenticated device id
units.source_record_hex: exact selected UTF-8 line, unknown fields retained
units.source_record_index: zero-based original physical line with window CLI
units.source_file_sha256: original bytes digest with window CLI; not authentication
units.selected_normalized_sha256: LF-normalized selected content digest, distinct from original
